Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer introduced unverified assumptions for annual pass prices (“$150 per adult and $75 per student”) and treated memberships as per-person without confirming the Philadelphia Museum of Art’s actual membership pricing/structure (e.g., Individual ~ $75, Student discounted, Family/Dual options). This incorrect assumption drove the annual pass total and led directly to the wrong savings result.
